recipes.title: Cranberry Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: A delightful combination of fresh blueberries and dried cranberries in a tender buttermilk muffin.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

In a large bowl combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. In another bowl, combine the vanilla, buttermilk, egg and cooled butter. Bring together with a fork. Add the buttermilk mixture to the flour mixture and stir to just combine.
Fold in the blueberries and cranberries. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins. Bake for about 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake Muffins
recipes.description: Light and tender muffins with bright lemon flavor, topped with whipped cream and a lemon wedge.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line muffin tins with muffin papers.
In a large bowl combine the sifted cake flour with the sugar, baking powder and salt. In another bowl combine the vanilla, buttermilk and oil. When mixed add the pudding.

Zest and juice three lemons. Set aside the fourth lemon. Add the lemon juice to the wet mixture and the zest to the dry mixture. Using a third bowl, alternate combining wet and dry ingredients, giving a quick mix after each addition. Spoon batter into prepared muffin tins and bake in the preheated oven for about 20-25 minutes or until done in the middle. Cool completely.
While the muffins are cooling slice the remaining lemon and cut into small triangles. When the muffins have cooled, add a spoonful of whip cream and top with one lemon wedge. Serve.

recipes.title: Pomegranate Blueberry Energy Muffins
recipes.description: A superfood-packed muffin featuring fresh blueberries, pomegranate seeds, and dark chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Slice into pomegranate and gut out 1/2 cup seeds; set aside.

In a large bowl combine flour, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder and salt. In a small bowl combine sugar with butter (cooled), egg and buttermilk. Gently combine the buttermilk mixture with the flour mixture.
Fold in blueberries, pomegranate seeds and dark chocolate chips. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins and bake for about 20-25 minutes or until done in the middle. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Autumn Time Muffins
recipes.description: Warmly spiced pumpkin muffins with whole wheat flour, molasses, and fresh pomegranate seeds.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Slice into a pomegranate and remove the seeds; set aside a 1/2 cup.

In a large bowl combine flours, baking soda, baking powder, pumpkin pie spice and salt; set aside. In a medium bowl combine melted butter with molasses until smooth. Add vegetable oil, eggs and buttermilk. Gradually add the pumpkin and stir till combined. Make a well in the middle of the dry ingredients and add the pumpkin mixture. Stir about 8-10 times; don't overwork.
Toss in the pomegranate seeds and combine. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins. Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mint Muffins
recipes.description: Rich chocolate muffins with refreshing mint flavor from peppermint extract and mint chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl combine the sifted cake flour with the baking powder, salt and cocoa.
In another bowl, combine the sugar, eggs, butter (cooled), peppermint extract and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the milk to the butter mixture.
Combine the wet ingredients with the dry ingredients; don't over mix. Toss in the chocolate chips and mint chocolate chips and combine.
Spoon batter into greased or paper lined muffin tins, until just from the top. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Vanilla Buttermilk Muffins
recipes.description: Extra-moist vanilla muffins with pudding and yogurt for tender texture.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

In a large bowl combine the sifted cake flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt. In another bowl combine the egg, vanilla, buttermilk and oil. In a small bowl combine the vanilla pudding and the vanilla yogurt.

Add the yogurt mixture with the other wet ingredients and combine all ingredients together. Spoon batter into greased or paper lined muffin tins. Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until done in the center. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Holiday Gingerbread Pumpkin Muffins
recipes.description: Warmly spiced muffins combining gingerbread flavors with pumpkin - perfect for fall and winter holidays.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, brown sugar, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, ginger and allspice. In another bowl combine the eggs, oil, applesauce, milk, vanilla and molasses.
Once mixed, add the pumpkin. Combine the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just mixed.
Scoop batter in greased or paper lined muffin tins. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the center comes out clean when a toothpick is inserted.

recipes.title: Peter Rabbit Carrot Cake Muffins
recipes.description: Classic carrot cake flavors in muffin form with shredded carrots, raisins, and toasted pecans.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Spread pecans out on a cookie sheet and bake in a preheated oven for 5-8 minutes or until lightly toasted. Set aside.

In a large bowl bring together the flour, sugar and salt. In another bowl, combine the egg, vanilla, milk, applesauce and oil until just combined. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients. Add the carrots, raisins and pecans, being careful not to over mix.
Bake in greased or paper lined muffin tins for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Mid-Day Pick-Me-Up Muffins
recipes.description: A delightful combination of pumpkin, chocolate chips, and blueberries with a crunchy oat crumb topping.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Grease or line muffin tins; set aside.
In a small bowl, combine all of the crumb toppings; set aside. In a large bowl combine the flour, sugar, baking powder and cinnamon.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg, milk, vanilla and pumpkin. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and lightly mix. Add the chocolate chips and fold in the blueberries.
Scoop the batter into the prepared muffin tins. Top each muffin with a tablespoon of crumb topping. Bake for 20-25 minutes. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Muffins
recipes.description: Spiced apple muffins with chunks of caramel that ooze out when baked - a fall favorite!

ingredients.item: Granny Smith apples, peeled and cubed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Prepare the muffin tins by lining with paper muffin cups.

Peel and cube the apples; set aside. Chop up the caramel squares and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. In a medium bowl combine the sugar, butter, egg, milk and vanilla.

Gently combine the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, adding the apples and caramels while mixing. Scoop batter into prepared muffin tins and bake for 20-25 minutes or until batter is cooked in the middle and caramels are oozing out!

recipes.title: Chocolate Hazelnut Muffins
recipes.description: Rich chocolate muffins studded with toasted hazelnuts and chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Grease muffin tins and set aside.

Fold in the chocolate chips and hazelnuts; don't over mix. Spoon batter into prepared muffin tins and bake for about 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Blackberry Chocolate Muffins with Crumb Topping

recipes.title: Ginger Lemon Muffins
recipes.description: A great muffin to go with your morning coffee, featuring fresh ginger and lemon zest.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
Combine the sugar, lemon zest and ginger in a food processor and pulse until well combined.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk and butter. Add in the ginger and lemon zest mixture and mix well.

recipes.title: Pancakes

Break the eggs into a separate bowl and whisk together with the milk.
Gradually add the milk and egg mixture to the flour mixture and whisk to a smooth batter.
Heat a frying pan over a medium heat and melt a small knob of butter. Pour the batter into the pan, using approximately 1/4 cup for each pancake.
When the top of the pancake begins to bubble, turn and cook the other side until golden brown.
Serve with butter and maple syrup.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cheesecake
recipes.description: Creamy cheesecake topped with fresh blueberry sauce.

instructions.text: Melt the butter and pour onto the cracker crumbs and mix well. Press into the bottom of a 9-inch spring form pan. Bake at 325°F until the crust is set, about 10-12 minutes. Allow to cool.
In a large bowl beat the cream cheese with the flour, caster sugar, eggs, soured cream and vanilla extract with an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
Pour the mixture into the pan and bake for 35-40 minutes until set. Remove from the oven and leave to cool.

Heat half the blueberries in a pan with 2 tablespoons icing sugar and stir gently until juicy. Squash the blueberries with a fork then continue to cook for a few minutes. Add the remaining blueberries, remove from the heat and allow to cool.
Pour the blueberries over the cheesecake just before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Tart
recipes.description: Classic French lemon tart with buttery pastry shell and tangy lemon curd filling.

instructions.text: In a large bowl mix the softened butter and icing sugar to a cream with a wooden spoon then beat in the egg yolk. Add the flour and salt and rub the butter mixture and flour together with your fingers until crumbly.
Add the egg yolk to the mixture and knead briefly until it forms a firm dough. Wrap in plastic wrap and leave to chill in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Roll out the pastry until very thin and line the quiche tin allowing a small amount of pastry to overlap the edges. Prick the base of the pastry with a fork and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

Grate the zest from the lemons into a bowl then add the juice from the lemons. Break the eggs into a large bowl and add the caster sugar and mix well. Add the lemon juice, zest and the cream and whisk gently.
Pour the mixture into the pastry case and bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes until set.
Sprinkle with a little icing sugar and serve with cream.

recipes.title: Pasta Puttanesca

instructions.text: Cook the pasta as directed on the instructions.
At the same time, heat the oil and butter in a separate pan and gently fry the garlic and anchovies for 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, tomato puree, olives, capers and fry for 7-8 minutes, stirring from time to time.
Drain the pasta, pour over the sauce and serve with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Tuna Nicoise Salad
recipes.description: Classic French composed salad with tuna, potatoes, green beans, eggs, and olives.

Top and tail the beans and boil in water for 5 minutes, cool in ice water.
Tear the lettuce into small pieces and arrange on a large plate.
Chop the tomatoes into quarters and add to the plate.
Cut the tuna into large chunks and add to the plate.
Add the potatoes, beans, sliced onion, eggs, olives and scatter over the chopped parsley.
In a small bowl mix the oil, vinegar, garlic, salt and pepper. Pour over the salad and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies

recipes.title: Chex Party Mix

Store in airtight container.
Oven Prep: Pre-heat oven to 250°F. Put cereal and seasoning mixture into ungreased roasting pan and bake for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Spread on paper towels to cool, about 15 minutes.

notes: Can be made in microwave or oven

recipes.title: Arayes - Stuffed Pitas with Garlic Tahini Sauce
recipes.description: Middle Eastern stuffed pita pockets with spiced ground beef, served with creamy garlic tahini sauce.

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grate your onion and squeeze every last drop of liquid out using paper towel or cheesecloth.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, tomato paste, minced garlic, all the spices, parsley, cilantro (if using), and that very dry grated onion. Mix with your hands for about 2 minutes.

Cut each pita in half. If they don't already have a pocket, carefully use a knife to make one. Now, pack them with your beef mixture - and I mean stuff them. You want them full but not bursting (ripped pita = heartbreak).

Crisp 'Em Up: Brush the outsides of the stuffed pitas lightly with olive oil. Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat. Place each arayes meat-side down and sear for 1-2 minutes until you get that gorgeous crust. Then sear the pita sides until golden and crisp.
Transfer the seared arayes to a baking sheet and finish them in the oven for 10-15 minutes, until fully cooked through.
While they bake, whisk together all the garlic tahini sauce ingredients in a bowl. Taste and adjust lemon, salt, or garlic levels to your liking.
When the arayes are hot out of the oven, optionally brush them with melted garlic herb butter. Totally optional... but trust me, it hits. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Butter Chicken - 20 Minutes
recipes.description: Quick and flavorful Indian butter chicken with creamy tomato-based sauce.

ingredients.item: paprika or Kashmiri red chilli powder

ingredients.prep_note: slit or chopped, optional for heat

instructions.text: Prep the chicken.
Marinate chicken thighs with yogurt, lemon juice and the spice listed above and air fry for 12 minutes at 400°F.
Cook the base.

Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet or pan over medium heat. Add the whole spices listed above and toast the spices (~30 seconds) then add in the roughly sliced onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add the minced garlic, ginger, and green chili (if using), tomato paste, and 1/4 cup water. Sauté for another 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Blend up the mixture.
Remove the bay leaf and black cardamom pod and add the rest into a blender and blend until smooth.
Make the sauce.

Pour the mixture back in the pan and add 1/2 cup water, the spices listed above, 2 tbsp of salted butter, 1/2 cup of heavy cream and 2 tbsp kasoori methi. Cook for 4-5 minutes on medium heat and let the gravy get thick.
Add the chicken.
Take the chicken out of the air fryer and roughly chop it into bite size pieces, add the cooked chicken to the sauce and stir to coat evenly. Let it simmer for 1-2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and sugar if needed.
Garnish and serve.
Garnish with fresh cilantro. Serve hot with steamed basmati rice, naan, or roti.

notes: Can substitute coconut cream for dairy-free option

recipes.title: Caramelized Onion and Garlic Spaghetti
recipes.description: Creamy pasta with deeply caramelized onions and garlic, topped with chili crisp.

instructions.text: Slice your onion like it owes you money, mince that garlic (use fresh please), and measure out all your seasoning. Bring a cup of cream or coconut milk to room temperature.

Heat 2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add in the onions and let them vibe for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and jammy. If they start sticking, hit 'em with a splash of water.
While your onions are caramelizing like sweet little angels, boil a pot of salted water and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain, but don't forget to save some of that pasta water - it's liquid gold.

When the onions are deeply golden, stir in your minced garlic and all the seasonings. Let it all bloom for a minute, then add the chili crisp and saute for a minute. Pour in your cream (or coconut milk). Let it simmer and get cozy for a few minutes then add the grated Parmesan cheese.
Add your pasta to the sauce and toss to coat. Use that reserved pasta water to loosen things up if it's too thick - you're going for silky, not sticky.
Serve hot with an extra spoon of chili crisp on top for a spicy kick and maybe a sprinkle of fresh parsley if you're feelin' fancy.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Hawaiian Chicken
recipes.description: Slow cooker Hawaiian chicken with crushed pineapple and ginger.

instructions.text: Crock Pot Hawaiian Chicken:
Place the crushed pineapple with juice, soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic in a large bowl and whisk to combine.
Place the chicken in the slow cooker, pour the sauce over and turn to coat.
Cook on low 4 hours or on high 2 hours, or until chicken is cooked through.
Serve over rice and top with extra sauce. Instructions to thicken the sauce if desired are below.
Thickening the Sauce (optional):
Combine 1 cup leftover juice, 1 teaspoon corn starch, and 1 teaspoon soy sauce in a sauce pan over medium high heat. Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer until thickened.

recipes.title: Crockpot Hawaiian Chicken
recipes.description: Slow cooker Hawaiian chicken with bell peppers, pineapple cubes, and honey soy glaze.

instructions.text: Spray your crockpot with nonstick spray. Then, season the chicken with salt and pepper and place it into the bottom of the crockpot.

Add the bell peppers, onion, pineapple, garlic, ginger, and sugar to the crockpot as well. Next, whisk the soy sauce and honey together in a small bowl, then pour that over top of the chicken and veggies.

Cook the chicken on LOW for 4-5 hours. Then, whisk the arrowroot/cornstarch and water together to create a paste, and pour it into your crockpot, giving everything a good stir. Continue cooking for 30-40 more minutes until the sauce as thickened.
Serve chicken over rice or with your favorite vegetables and garnish with green onions. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Hachis Parmentier
recipes.description: Classic French comfort dish - ground beef stew topped with piped mashed potatoes, similar to shepherd's pie.

instructions.text: Season and sear beef in oil until nicely browned. Remove with a slotted spoon.
Saute carrot, onion, celery in the remaining fat for 3 minutes until browned.
Add garlic and continue to cook 1 minute.
Add tomato paste, cook 3 more minutes.
Add flour and stir in.
Deglaze with wine, cook until thickened.
Add stock, beef and thyme. Stir while cooking until thickened. Cook covered for 20 minutes.
While beef is stewing make the mashed potato.
Fill oven safe dish with beef filling, pipe the potato on top.
Bake at 425°F fan for 20 minutes or until golden brown on top. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken
recipes.description: Skillet Hawaiian chicken with pineapple, bell peppers, and sticky sweet sauce served over rice.

instructions.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season chicken with salt and pepper then add to the skillet.
Sear outside until a nice golden crust forms.
Remove chicken from pan, add in bell peppers and saute for 3-5 minutes until tender, remove from pan.
Add sauce ingredients to pan, and bring to a simmer, add chicken back in, and cook on medium-low heat, letting sauce reduce while chicken cooks through.
Add peppers and pineapple to pan, and cook a few minutes more, until sauce is thick, sticky, and glossy, and peppers are tender.
Serve over cooked white rice.

recipes.title: Sweet Hawaiian Crockpot Chicken
recipes.description: Easy slow cooker Hawaiian chicken with barbecue sauce and pineapple.

instructions.text: Place the chicken thighs in your slow cooker and seasoning with salt and pepper.
Add the onion, bell pepper, soy sauce, barbecue sauce, brown sugar, 1 cup of the pineapple chunks and 1/2 cup of the pineapple juice.
Cover and cook on low for 4 hours until the temperature of the chicken reaches 160°F when measured with a digital meat thermometer. Note: the chicken is not done yet. See next step.

In a small bowl, mix the cornstarch with 1/2 cup of the reserved pineapple juice until smooth. Stir into the slow cooker to thicken up the sauce. Cook until the sauce is thickened and the chicken measures 165°F.
Serve over rice of choice and add leftover pineapple chunks as garnish, along with green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Cheesy Pasta Skillet
recipes.description: Quick one-pan cheesy pasta with ground beef and tortellini.

instructions.text: Brown the hamburger meat in a large skillet then drain off the fat.
Add the tortellini, water, garlic powder, and onion powder and stir together.
Bring the skillet to a boil, reduce heat, and cover.
Cook until the tortellini is soft then drain off the excess water.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Sprinkle the cheese over the mixture evenly and let it melt then serve.

notes: Serve with Roasted Asparagus

recipes.title: Goldie Chicken
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken with a sweet and savory brown sugar ginger sauce.

instructions.text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper and cook until golden on the outside and completely white on the inside. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté the cloves of garlic for 2 minutes then put them on the plate with the chicken.

Once again, in the same skillet over medium high heat, pour 1/2 cup of water and scrape the bottom of the skillet with a wooden spatula to get all the browned bits dissolved (this is called deglazing the pan).
Whisk the brown sugar into the skillet until it is dissolved. Cook for about 5 minutes.
Add in the vinegar and stir.
Add in the garlic, ginger, chicken broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Cook until the sauce thickens, about 10 minutes.
Once the sauce has thickened, return the chicken to the skillet and heat.
Serve with rice and garnish with scallions or green onions.

notes: Serve with Sriracha Zucchini
Scrape the bottom of the skillet with a wooden spatula to get all the browned bits dissolved (this is called deglazing the pan).

recipes.title: Hamburger Steaks
recipes.description: Classic hamburger steaks with caramelized onions and brown gravy.

instructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, bread crumbs, and 1 tsp of Worcestershire sauce. Divide the mixture into 4 patties.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tbsp of olive oil and 1 tbsp of butter over medium-high heat.
Add the patties to the skillet and cook on each side until cooked all the way through.
Place the patties on a plate and set aside.
Add the sliced onions to the same skillet over medium-high heat and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the broth, ketchup, the other tsp of Worcestershire, salt, and pepper to the skillet.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and 1 tbsp of water. Whisk this mixture into the skillet. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to low.
Add the patties back to the skillet and heat through.

notes: Serve with mashed potatoes or rice and green beans

recipes.title: Philly Cheesesteak
recipes.description: Classic Philly cheesesteak sandwiches with sautéed onions, peppers, and melted provolone.

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees F.
Spray a large skillet with cooking spray and heat to medium-high.
Season the sliced steak with salt and pepper and cook until cooked through.
Add in the onions and peppers and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Slice the hoagie rolls long ways down the center.
Place 2 slices of cheese on one side of each roll.
Top the other side of each roll with steak, peppers, and onions.
Place the open rolls in the oven for 3-5 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

notes: Place the open rolls in the oven for 3-5 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp Pasta
recipes.description: Quick pasta with garlic shrimp, brown sugar glaze, and parmesan cheese.

instructions.text: Cook the noodles according to package directions.
Pour the olive oil, garlic, soy sauce, and brown sugar into a large ziplock bag and add in the shrimp.
Seal the bag and shake to coat the shrimp with the sauce.
Add the shrimp to a large skillet over medium-high heat. Saute for 3-5 minutes.
Add the red pepper flakes, parmesan cheese, and cooked noodles.
Cook for another 3-4 minutes until the noodles and shrimp are combined with the cheese.

notes: Cook for another 3-4 minutes until the noodles and shrimp are combined with the cheese.

recipes.title: Double Decker Tacos
recipes.description: Taco Bell-inspired double decker tacos with refried beans holding soft and hard shells together.

instructions.text: In a large skillet over medium high heat, brown your ground beef then drain off the fat.
Stir the water and the taco seasoning into the meat and mix well. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Rotel tomatoes and kidney beans to the meat, if using.
Heat the hard taco shells in the oven for 5 minutes at 350 degrees.
Heat the soft taco shells in the microwave in for 30 seconds.
Heat the refried beans in the microwave or in a saucepan on the stove.
Spoon a spoonful of refried beans onto each soft shell and spread evenly.
Place the hard taco shell upright down the center of the soft taco shell and stick the soft shell to the hard shell.
Spoon ground beef mixture into the hard shell and top with desired toppings. I use onions, lettuce, cheese, and hot sauce.

notes: I use onions, lettuce, cheese, and hot sauce for toppings.

recipes.title: Simple Shrimp Gumbo
recipes.description: Cajun-style shrimp gumbo with a dark roux and vegetables.

instructions.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sprinkle the flour into the skillet and stir it constantly until the flour has browned. Turn off the heat.
Transfer the oil and flour (the roux) to a large soup pot.
Pour the chicken broth into the soup pot and bring it to a boil. Lower heat and stir well.
Add in the celery, bell pepper, onion, tomatoes, salt, pepper, thyme, bay leaves, and Cajun seasoning.
Let everything simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add in the liquid smoke and shrimp and cook for 3-5 minutes, or until shrimp begins to turn pink.
Serve over rice.

notes: Transfer the oil and flour mixture (the roux) to a large soup pot.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Corn Soup
recipes.description: Creamy corn soup with fresh corn and Greek yogurt.

instructions.text: Cut the corn from the cob and set corn aside.
Heat the oil in a soup pot over medium heat and sauté the onion for 3-4 minutes.
Add the chicken stock and bring it to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add the corn, creamed corn, cumin, and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the green onion and plain Greek yogurt. Stir well and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper before serving.

notes: Season with salt and pepper before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
recipes.description: Mexican-style chicken soup with tomatoes, salsa, and fresh cilantro.

instructions.text: Heat olive oil in a large soup pot over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic into the pot and sauté for a couple of minutes.
Add the chicken pieces to the pot and cook until completely done.
Add the diced tomatoes, Rotel tomatoes, salsa, and ground cumin. Let simmer for 5 minutes.
Add in the chicken broth and let simmer for 20 minutes.
Before serving stir in the cilantro, salt, and pepper.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Roll-Ups
recipes.description: Easy pizza-style appetizers with crescent rolls, pepperoni, and cheese.

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees F.
Unroll the crescent rolls and separate them into 8 triangles.
Place 5 pepperonis and one string cheese half on the large end of the crescent roll.
Roll up the crescent rolls and sprinkle each of them with garlic powder.
Place the rolls on a greased baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve with warm marinara sauce.

notes: Serve with warm marinara sauce.

recipes.title: Asian Meatballs
recipes.description: Baked meatballs with hoisin glaze and sesame seeds.

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees F.
Grease a large baking sheet.
In a large bowl, mix together the ground beef, sesame oil, Panko crumbs, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 2 eggs, 3 tsp minced garlic, and green onions.
Shape this mixture into 1-2 inch balls, the size depending on your preference.
Place the balls on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 12 minutes or until no longer pink on the inside.
While the meatballs are baking, mix together the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ground ginger.
When the meatballs are finished baking, dip each one in the sauce and place on a serving dish.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the meatballs.

recipes.title: Mexican Skillet Casserole
recipes.description: One-pan Mexican-style rice and beef dish with beans and cheese.

instructions.text: Place 2 cups of water in a small pot. Add the rice and 1 tsp of salt. Bring to a boil. Boil for 7-8 minutes or until rice is done. Drain and set aside.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 2 tsp of oil. Saute the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Brown the ground beef in the same skillet. Drain and return to the skillet.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and 1 tsp of salt.
Add in the cooked rice, Rotel tomatoes, and beans. Cook for 2 minutes over medium-high heat.
Sprinkle the cheese over the mixture and let stand until the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Chicken Nuggets
recipes.description: Homemade baked chicken nuggets with oat and panko coating.

instructions.text: Cut your chicken breasts into chicken nugget sized chunks.
Preheat your oven to 375 degrees F.
Place the oats, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and in your food processor and pulse until powdery. Pour into a shallow bowl.
Pour the panko crumbs and parmesan cheese in another shallow bowl.
Roll the nuggets in the oatmeal mixture then the panko mixture.
Lay the nuggets on a foil lined baking sheet and lightly spray them with cooking spray.
Bake for 20 minutes, turning halfway through cooking time.

notes: Serve with green beans and Honey Glazed Carrots
Place the oats, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt in your food processor and pulse until powdery.

recipes.title: Lemon Pepper Chicken
recipes.description: Quick skillet chicken with lemon pepper seasoning and red pepper flakes.

instructions.text: Chop your chicken into 1-inch pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Saute the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.

Add the chicken to the pan and continue to cook for 7-10 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. I always cut a couple bigger pieces of chicken so I can cut them in half to make sure they are completely cooked through at the end of cooking time.
Add the lemon pepper, red pepper, salt, and pepper and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and deglaze the pan and cook for another couple of minutes.

notes: Serve with pasta, rice, or quinoa

recipes.title: Skillet Lasagna
recipes.description: One-pot stovetop lasagna with oven-ready noodles, ricotta, and mozzarella.

instructions.text: In a large pot, brown the ground beef then drain off the fat.
Season the browned ground beef with Italian seasoning, salt, and garlic.
Pour a third of the sauce on top of the meat, then add a layer of noodles. Repeat, ending with the sauce on top.
Evenly pour the chicken broth over everything in the pot.
Bring the pot to a boil and reduce heat to low and cook for 15 minutes. Stir gently every few minutes.
When the noodles are tender, gently stir in the cheeses.
Cover and let sit for five minutes then serve.

notes: Serve with Cheesy Garlic Bread

recipes.title: Sweet and Spicy Salmon
recipes.description: Foil-baked salmon with honey, soy, ginger, and Sriracha glaze.

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees F and line a baking sheet with foil.
In a small bowl, whisk together the honey, garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, oil, ginger, Sriracha, and pepper.
Place the salmon on the prepared baking sheet and fold the foil up around it.
Spoon the honey mixture over the salmon and fold the sides over it. Make sure the foil is sealed completely.
Place in the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes until the salmon is cooked through.
Open the foil and broil the salmon for 2 minutes.
Serve immediately.

notes: Serve with Roasted Asparagus or Sriracha Zucchini

recipes.title: Broccoli Shrimp Stir Fry
recipes.description: Quick Asian stir fry with shrimp, broccoli, and savory sauce.

instructions.text: In a small bowl whisk together the soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, oil, cornstarch, and Sriracha. Set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add in the shrimp and cook, stirring every few seconds, until they turn pink (about 2-3 minutes).
Add the broccoli to the skillet and cook, stirring every few seconds, for 3 minutes.
Stir the soy sauce mixture into the shrimp and broccoli and combine. Cook for 2 minutes or until the sauce is slightly thickened.
Serve immediately garnished with sesame seeds.

notes: Serve with rice

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
recipes.description: Buttery garlic shrimp with spinach and parmesan over fettuccine.

instructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package directions and drain well.
Melt 2 tbsp of butter in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the garlic, oregano, and red pepper to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add in the shrimp and cook, stirring frequently, for 2-3 minutes or until they are pink. Remove from skillet and set aside.
Melt the rest of the butter in the skillet and stir in the pasta, spinach, and parmesan cheese. Stir until the spinach begins to wilt, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the shrimp and serve immediately.

notes: Stir frequently to prevent sticking.

recipes.title: Pizza Pasta
recipes.description: One-pot pasta with Italian sausage, pepperoni, and pizza sauce.

instructions.text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet and sauté the onions and peppers for 5 minutes. Add in the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add in the Italian sausage and pepperoni. Cook until the sausage is browned.
Stir in the pasta, beef broth, tomato paste, pizza sauce, water, and Italian seasoning. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to medium low.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the pasta is tender. Stir occasionally.
Remove from heat and stir in the cheese. Cover and let sit for a couple minutes to let the cheese melt then serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Spaghetti
recipes.description: Easy creamy pasta with rotisserie chicken, Rotel, and cream of mushroom soup.

instructions.text: Cook the angel hair pasta according to package directions and drain.
While the pasta is cooking, shred the rotisserie chicken.
In a large bowl, stir together the shredded chicken, sour cream, Rotel tomatoes, and cream of mushroom soup.
After draining the pasta, stir the chicken mixture into the pot with the pasta.
Heat over medium-low heat for 5-10 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
recipes.description: Hearty Tex-Mex soup with ground beef, beans, corn, and taco seasoning.

instructions.text: Brown the ground beef in a large pot and drain.
Add in the rest of the ingredients and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.
Serve with Fritos and cheese.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.description: Classic homemade sloppy joes with tomato sauce and seasonings.

instructions.text: Brown the ground beef in a large saucepan and drain well.
Add in the tomato sauce, Worcestershire, mustard, salt, pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and cook over medium-high heat for 5-10 minutes.
Serve on hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Grits
recipes.description: Classic Southern shrimp and grits with bacon, white wine, and vegetables.

instructions.text: Fry bacon pieces in a large skillet until just crisp, not hard. Remove to a bowl.
Drain all but 1 tbsp of the bacon fat from the skillet.
Add the shrimp to the skillet. Stir and cook for 2-3 minutes over medium heat. Remove shrimp and juices to bowl with bacon.
Add butter to the skillet. Sauté onions, pepper, and mushrooms until tender.
Add pimento, parsley, lemon juice, garlic, salt, Worcestershire, wine and Tabasco to the skillet.
When mixture comes to a simmer, add bacon and shrimp. Stir to mix all ingredients. Let simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Add small can of tomato sauce and simmer couple more minutes.
Cook 1/2 cup to 1 cup of grits per serving. Can add cheese if you like. Cook grits according to package directions.
Serve shrimp mixture over grits.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
recipes.description: Classic pan-fried salmon patties with cornmeal coating.

instructions.text: In a large bowl, mix together the Salmon, egg, cracker crumbs, onion, and garlic powder.
Form the mixture into small patties.
In a small bowl, mix together the corn meal and flour.
Roll the salmon patties in the corn meal mixture.
Fry in hot cooking oil until both sides are lightly browned.

notes: Serve with Mediterranean Vegetables

recipes.title: Spaghetti
recipes.description: Homemade spaghetti with fresh meat sauce.

instructions.text: Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain and set aside.
Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat and saute the onion for 3 minutes.
Add water to a large pot. Salt the water and put it over medium-high heat. This is for boiling your noodles.
Add the garlic and saute for 1 minute.
Add in the tomatoes, oregano, parsley, and the browned ground beef. Bring to a steady simmer.
Season with salt and pepper. Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the noodles to the water from step 4 when it starts boiling. Boil according to package directions.
Drain the noodles and serve topped with the meat sauce and parmesan cheese.

notes: While the sauce and noodles are cooking, prepare some cheesy garlic bread to go with the spaghetti!

recipes.title: Cheesy Garlic Bread
recipes.description: Classic cheesy garlic bread - perfect side for pasta dishes.

instructions.text: Heat your oven to 400 degrees F.
Cut loaf down the middle and place on a baking pan.
In a small bowl, mix together the butter, olive oil, garlic, and parsley.
Spread the butter mixture over the bread.
Top each side of the bread with cheese.
Bake for 5-8 minutes.
Remove from the oven and cut into strips.

recipes.title: Roasted Asparagus
recipes.description: Simple roasted asparagus with honey-balsamic glaze.

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees F.
Mix the garlic, olive oil, honey, vinegar, and salt in a small bowl.
Place the asparagus on a lined baking sheet.
Pour the mixture evenly over the asparagus.
Roast for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sriracha Zucchini
recipes.description: Spicy stir-fried zucchini with ginger, garlic, and Sriracha.

instructions.text: Heat a large saucepan over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Stir in the ginger and the garlic and cook for 3-5 minutes.
Add the zucchini and cook for about 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, and Sriracha sauce. Stir well.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Top with fresh cilantro before serving.

notes: This is a great side dish for Goldie Chicken.

recipes.title: Honey Glazed Carrots
recipes.description: Sweet and tangy glazed carrots with honey and red wine vinegar.

instructions.text: Heat oil over medium-high heat in a large skillet.
Add the carrots and cook for about 2 minutes.
Add the broth, honey, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Uncover and cook until carrots are tender and liquid has thickened, about 8-9 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and add in butter and stir.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Vegetables
recipes.description: Sautéed zucchini, onion, and bell pepper with Greek seasoning.

instructions.text: Cut the zucchini into eighths lengthwise, then in half crosswise.
Add 2 tbsp of olive oil to a large skillet and heat over medium-high heat.
Add the zucchini, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet. Cook and stir for 6-8 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tsp olive oil, Greek seasoning, balsamic vinegar, garlic salt, and sugar.
Remove the skillet from the heat and drizzle on oil/seasoning mixture and toss well to coat.
Serve immediately.

notes: Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pineapple Lemon Juice
recipes.description: Fresh pineapple and lemon juice for digestive health.

instructions.text: Take the pineapple, remove the skin and cut it into cubes.
Cut the lemon in quarters, leaving the skin on.
Run the ingredients through the juicer and enjoy!

notes: Health relevance: Pineapple and lemon act as natural detergents for the intestine

recipes.title: Pear Juice
recipes.description: Simple fresh pear juice - excellent for rheumatism and arthritis.

instructions.text: Core the pears but you can leave the peel on.
Juice and enjoy!

notes: Health relevance: Pear juice is excellent for rheumatism, arthritis and gout due to its ability to dissolve uric acid crystals

recipes.title: Papaya Energy Drink
recipes.description: Energizing juice with papaya, orange, and kale.

instructions.text: Peel the orange and papaya, remove papaya seeds.
Juice and enjoy!

notes: Health relevance: This juice gives instant energy and a sense of wellbeing

recipes.title: Elixir of Youth #3
recipes.description: Anti-aging juice with papaya, ginger, and kale.

instructions.text: Peel the papaya and remove seeds.
Clean kale thoroughly.
Juice and enjoy!

notes: Health relevance: Ginger and kale combination boosts the immune system and has powerful anti-aging effects

recipes.title: Antioxidant Delight
recipes.description: Antioxidant-rich juice with garlic, carrot, beet, and celery.

instructions.text: Clean beets and carrots thoroughly.
Remove the skin from the garlic.
Juice and enjoy!

recipes.title: The Bright Juice Cocktail
recipes.description: Carrot, apple, and celery juice for eyes, skin, and energy.

instructions.text: Peel the carrots and dice.
Core the apple but leave the skin on.
Chop the celery stalk.
Run all ingredients through the juicer/blender.

notes: Health relevance: Excellent for eyes, skin and fat reduction

recipes.title: The Best Cold Remedy
recipes.description: Immune-boosting juice for fighting colds.

instructions.text: Peel the oranges and lemon.
Juice all ingredients together.

recipes.title: Detox Juice
recipes.description: Multi-vegetable cleansing juice for blood, liver, and kidneys.

instructions.text: Core the apples, but leave the skin on.
Peel and chop the carrots, beet and cucumber.
Chop the celery, green pepper.
Run all ingredients through the juicer.

notes: Health relevance: Cleanses blood, liver and kidneys while reducing body acidity
To improve the taste, you could add a little sea salt to the juice, stir and drink.

recipes.title: Mango Delight
recipes.description: Tropical juice with mango, greens, and honeydew melon.

instructions.text: Chop the pepper, lettuce and spinach.
Peel the carrots and dice.
Chop the mango.
Peel and chop the melon.
Run all through the juicer.

recipes.title: Pomegranate Antioxidant Juice
recipes.description: High antioxidant juice with pomegranate, carrots, and fruit.

instructions.text: Take the seeds out of the pomegranate fruit.
Peel and dice the carrots.
Core and peel the apple and chop.
Dissolve the honey in water before adding to the juice.
Run through the juicer/blender.

notes: Health relevance: High in antioxidants, great for gum disorders and digestive problems

recipes.title: Juice for Urinary Tract Infections
recipes.description: Healing juice blend for urinary tract health.

instructions.text: Wash all ingredients thoroughly.
Core the apple.
Juice all ingredients together.

recipes.title: Extreme Blue Cheese Quiche
recipes.description: Rich and creamy quiche with bold blue cheese flavor.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all the necessary ingredients out including the pie crust.
First, heat the butter and cook the red onion and herbs together for 5-6 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the eggs, ricotta cheese, blue cheese, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked veggies and herbs to the egg mixture, then mix again.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place it in the oven to bake.
Bake for anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dish.

recipes.title: Mexican Style Quiche
recipes.description: Tex-Mex inspired quiche with ground turkey, taco seasoning, and sour cream.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Brown the ground turkey with olive oil, onion, and garlic. Add taco seasoning.
In a bowl, combine eggs, sour cream, tomatoes, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked turkey mixture to the egg mixture.
Pour into pie crust and bake for 45-60 minutes until golden and set.

recipes.title: Fresh Tomato Quiche
recipes.description: Refreshing quiche with fresh sliced tomatoes, herbs, and cheese.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Sauté garlic and onion in olive oil until softened.
In a bowl, combine eggs, ricotta, half the shredded cheese, herbs, salt.
Layer tomato slices in pie crust, pour egg mixture over.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 45-60 minutes until golden and set.

recipes.title: Delightful Crab Quiche
recipes.description: Elegant seafood quiche with crab meat, dill, and cream.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Combine crab meat, sour cream, heavy cream, dill, green onions, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake 45-60 minutes until golden and set.

notes: Can substitute imitation crab if preferred

recipes.title: Corn and More Quiche
recipes.description: Hearty quiche with kernel corn, mushrooms, and Italian cheeses.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Sauté onion, garlic, and mushrooms until softened.
In a bowl, combine eggs, cottage cheese, milk, corn, and half the Italian cheese.
Add sautéed vegetables and mix.
Pour into pie crust, top with remaining cheese.
Bake 45-60 minutes until golden and set.

recipes.title: Delicious Carrot Quiche
recipes.description: A unique carrot quiche with ricotta and Asiago cheese, enhanced with cinnamon and nutmeg.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all the necessary ingredients out including the pie crust.
Heat the butter and cook the shredded carrots with the onion.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients including the cooked veggies.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes.

recipes.title: Simple Leek Quiche
recipes.description: A delicious quiche featuring leeks with tomatoes, walnuts, and mozzarella cheese.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all the necessary ingredients out including the pie crust.
Heat the butter and cook the leeks.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients including the leeks.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes.

recipes.title: Olives and Sundried Tomato Quiche
recipes.description: A Greek-inspired quiche with black olives, sun-dried tomatoes, feta cheese, and fresh mint.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all your needed ingredients out including the pie crust.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes.

recipes.title: Mini Meat Quiches
recipes.description: Kid-friendly mini quiches made in a muffin tin with seasoned ground beef and sharp cheddar.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all the necessary ingredients out.
Spray with non-stick oil a muffin pan and set aside.
Heat a little oil, then cook the ground beef with water, seasonings, and onion.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients including the ingredients you already cooked.
Pour the final mixture into the muffin tin place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your mini quiches are nice and golden.

recipes.title: Sweet Potatoes Quiche
recipes.description: A creative quiche featuring shredded sweet potatoes with honey, Parmesan, and warm spices.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all the necessary ingredients out, including the pie crust.
Heat the butter and cook the onion and shredded potato.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients including the cooked veggies.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes.

recipes.title: Spectacular Mushroom Quiche
recipes.description: A rich mushroom quiche with Swiss cheese, fresh herbs, and half and half cream.

ingredients.prep_note: such as thyme, oregano, sage, parsley and chives

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all the necessary ingredients out including the pie crust.
Heat the butter and cook the mushrooms, onion, garlic, and herbs.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients. Mix well.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes.

recipes.title: Very Yummy Asparagus Quiche
recipes.description: A springtime favorite with asparagus, goat cheese, and banana peppers.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all the necessary ingredients out including the pie crust.
Cook the asparagus in a steamer basket for just 5 minutes, just to pre-cook them.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients including the asparagus.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage Quiche
recipes.description: A hearty breakfast quiche with Italian sausage, bell peppers, and white cheddar cheese.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all the necessary ingredients out including the pie crust.
Heat the butter and cook the onion, red bell pepper, and ground Italian sausage. Cook until done.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients, cooked veggies, and sausage.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes.

recipes.title: Avocado and More Quiche
recipes.description: A unique quiche featuring avocado with cottage cheese, mozzarella, and Dijon mustard.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all the necessary ingredients out including the pie crust.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes.

recipes.title: Sublime Salmon Quiche
recipes.description: A sophisticated salmon quiche with green beans and Asiago cheese, inspired by mom's salmon pie.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all your needed ingredients out including the pie crust.
Heat the butter and cook the onion and beans for 5 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes.

recipes.title: Blackberry and Cheese Quiche
recipes.description: The only fruity quiche in the cookbook - fresh blackberries with ricotta and Swiss cheese, enhanced with cinnamon and cayenne.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Get all your needed ingredients out including the pie crust.
Heat the butter and cook the sweet onion for 5 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients without the berries. When mixed well, add the blackberries carefully.
Pour the final mixture into the pie crust and place in the oven to bake.
Bake anywhere between 45-60 minutes depending on your oven. Make sure the eggs are fully cooked and your quiche is nice and golden.
Slice and serve with your favorite side dishes like mashed or fried sweet potatoes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter-Banana Bread
recipes.description: A moist banana bread with peanut butter, flaxseed, and a peanut butter glaze.

instructions.text: To prepare bread, combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; beat with a mixer at medium speed. Add granulated and brown sugars; beat until blended.
Weigh or lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups; level with a knife. Combine flour and next 5 ingredients (through allspice) in a small bowl.
Add flour mixture to banana mixture; beat just until blended. Stir in nuts.
Pour batter into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Remove from oven; cool 10 minutes in pan on a wire rack. Remove bread from pan; cool.
To prepare glaze, combine powdered sugar, milk, and 1 tablespoon peanut butter in a small bowl, stirring with a whisk. Drizzle glaze over bread.

recipes.title: German Farmer-Style Rye Bread
recipes.description: An authentic German rye bread with a long fermentation for added flavor, using caraway seeds.

instructions.text: Add the ingredients for the starter to a large bowl and mix together until smooth. Set aside for 10 minutes for the yeast to activate.
While the starter is resting, mix together the remaining ingredients except for the oil and cornmeal.

Pour the flour mixture over the starter. Do not stir. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a clean towel and set aside for at least two hours and up to five hours. The starter will bubble up through the flour mixture.

Add the oil to the flour mixture and use a wooden spoon to stir the flour mixture into the starter. As the mixture comes together, remove the dough to a lightly floured work surface and knead for about 10 minutes, or until smooth and elastic.
Set the dough aside to rest for about 10 minutes, then knead for another 5 to 10 minutes.

Set the dough in a large, lightly oiled bowl and lightly oil the top of the dough. Cover with plastic wrap or a clean towel and set in a draft-free area of the kitchen to rise until doubled in size, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Remove the dough to a lightly floured work surface. Punch down the dough and lightly knead it 3 or 4 times. Form into a ball, return to the bowl, cover and let rise for another 45 minutes or so.
Preheat oven to 450°F and set the shelf at the lowest level. Put a small metal pan in the oven.
Lightly press down on the dough and form it into a ball. Sprinkle the cornmeal onto a baking sheet and set the dough onto the baking sheet, with any seams on the bottom.
Lightly oil the top of the dough and cover it with plastic wrap. Set aside to rise for another hour.

Use a sharp knife or razor blade to slash the top of the dough in 3 parallel lines, each about 1/4-inch deep. Then slash with another set of 3 lines perpendicular to the first set. Use a spray bottle to mist the dough with water.

Set the baking sheet in the oven and pour about 1 cup of water into the small pan to create steam. Shut the door immediately and bake for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 400°F and bake for another 35 to 45 minutes. (An insta-read thermometer inserted into the middle of the loaf should register 190°F.)
Set the loaf on a cooling rack and let cool completely.

recipes.title: Garlic-Cilantro Naan Bread
recipes.description: Soft Indian-style flatbread topped with fresh garlic and cilantro, baked on a baking stone.

instructions.text: In a glass measuring cup, combine the yeast and sugar. Add the water and stir well. Let rest until foamy, about 5 minutes.

Sift the flour and salt together into a large bowl. Make a well in the center of the flour and pour in the yeast mixture, eggs, yogurt, and 1/4 cup ghee or oil. Mix together with your fingers until a smooth dough forms, working in a small amount of additional flour if needed. Knead for 3 minutes.
Oil a small bowl with the remaining 1 teaspoon ghee or oil. Place the dough in the bowl, turning to coat; cover with plastic wrap and let rest in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour.

Place a baking stone in the bottom of the oven and preheat oven to 400°F. Divide the dough into 6 pieces and gently roll into balls. Gently roll each ball into a 6-inch circle on a lightly floured surface.

Brush each circle with ghee or vegetable oil (about 2 teaspoons total) and top evenly with 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro and 4 cloves of garlic, finely chopped. Gently press the cilantro and garlic into the dough so they adhere.
Bake dough on the baking stone in batches until just golden brown and puffed, 8 to 10 minutes.
You should be able to bake two naan at a time on an average size baking stone. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Focaccia Bread
recipes.description: Classic Italian focaccia with olive oil, Italian herbs, and topped with Parmesan and mozzarella cheese.

instructions.text: In a large bowl, stir together the flour, salt, sugar, yeast, garlic powder, oregano, thyme, basil and black pepper. Mix in the vegetable oil and water.
When the dough has pulled together, turn it out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead until smooth and elastic. Lightly oil a large bowl, place the dough in the bowl, and turn to coat with oil.
Cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place for 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 450°F. Punch dough down; place on greased baking sheet. Pat into a 1/2 inch thick rectangle. Brush top with olive oil. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and mozzarella cheese.
Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Babka Bread
recipes.description: Rich Ukrainian Easter bread with golden raisins, lemon zest, and a buttery texture.

instructions.text: Make the dough: Coat a large bowl with oil and set aside. Combine the milk, yeast, the 1 tablespoon sugar, and 1 cup flour in a small bowl and set aside.

In the bowl of a standing mixer fitted with a dough hook, combine the remaining 6 cups flour, remaining sugar, salt, lemon zest, and raisins. With the mixer on low speed, add vanilla, egg yolks, 2 eggs, and the yeast mixture.

Mix on low speed until a smooth, elastic dough forms -- about 10 minutes. Add the 1/2 cup butter and mix for 5 more minutes. Transfer the dough to the prepared bowl, turning to coat all sides with oil. Cover the bowl with a clean, damp kitchen towel and set dough aside to rise in a warm, draft-free place until it doubles in volume -- about 1 hour.
Shape the loaf: Coat two 8-inch round by 4-inch-deep baking dishes with remaining butter and lightly dust with the 2 tablespoons flour, shaking out any excess. Set aside.

Punch down the dough, transfer it to a lightly floured surface, and divide it in half. Shape each half into a ball and place them in the prepared dishes. Cover with a clean, damp kitchen towel and let rise in a warm place until dough doubles in volume -- about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350°F.

Bake the bread: Beat the remaining egg and lightly brush the top of babkas. Bake in the lower third of the oven for 15 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 300°F and continue to bake until the loaves are golden and sound hollow when tapped -- about 40 more minutes.
Transfer the finished loaves to a wire rack to cool.

recipes.pan_size: Two 8-inch round by 4-inch deep baking dishes

recipes.title: Dutch Paasbrood
recipes.description: Traditional Dutch Easter bread with almond paste filling, golden raisins, and candied lemon peel.

instructions.text: Make the dough: Coat a large bowl with oil and set aside. Warm 1 cup of milk to 110°F in a small saucepan. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the yeast and the 1 tablespoon of sugar and let stand until bubbly.

In a large bowl or the bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade, combine the flour and cardamom. Add the whole eggs, butter, and yeast mixture and pulse to combine. Process the mixture or stir with a wooden spoon until a firm, sticky dough forms.

Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface, knead lightly, shape it into a ball, and transfer it to the prepared bowl, turning to coat all sides with oil. Cover the bowl with a clean, damp kitchen towel and let the dough rise in a warm, draft-free place until it doubles in volume -- about 40 minutes.

Make the almond paste: Place the almonds, remaining sugar, egg yolks, and lemon juice in the bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade and process into a firm paste. Place the almond paste on a 20-inch-long piece of plastic wrap. Roll the paste up lengthwise in the plastic wrap, twist the ends to seal, and shape the paste into a log about 1 inch thick and 12 inches long and refrigerate.

Shape the loaf: Preheat oven to 400°F. Punch down the dough and transfer it to a lightly floured surface. Place the raisins, lemon peel, and zest in the center of the dough and knead until they are incorporated and the dough is smooth. Roll the dough into a 6- by 13-inch rectangle.

Unwrap the almond paste and place it lengthwise in the center of the dough. Fold the dough over the paste and pinch to seal. Place the loaf, seal-side down, on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Cover the loaf and allow it to rise until it doubles in volume -- about 30 minutes.

Bake the bread: Glaze the loaf with the remaining milk and bake for 10 minutes in the center of the oven. Reduce temperature to 325°F and bake until loaf is golden brown and sounds hollow when tapped -- 40 to 45 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack to cool. Serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Cuban-Style Bread
recipes.description: Authentic Cuban bread with a distinctive seam created using palmetto leaves or shoestrings.

instructions.text: In a mixing machine fitted with a dough hook, add the water, salt, sugar, shortening, and yeast.
Add the flour slowly, making a stiff dough that is silky smooth.
Turn dough out into a large oiled bowl, cover with a cloth. Place dough in a warm place, and allow to double in bulk.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Pound and knead the dough, until it is silky smooth. Return the dough to the bowl, cover, and let rise again, until doubled in bulk.
Meanwhile, sterilize the palmetto leaves or shoe strings by soaking them in boiling water.

Portion dough into 10-ounce loaves. As a loaf is formed, immediately place a palmetto leaf or shoestring down the length of the loaf, and turn the loaf over onto a baking sheet, leaf/string side down. Repeat with the remaining loaves.
Let the dough rise, leaf side down, for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Bake loaves until they are golden brown, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Asian Poori Bread
recipes.description: Traditional Indian deep-fried puffed bread with cardamom and whole wheat flour.

instructions.text: Sift flours and salt into a medium bowl; add any bran remaining in sifter. Stir in cardamom seeds and 1 tablespoon oil; mix in enough of the water to make a soft dough.
Knead dough 5 minutes on a lightly oiled surface, with a little oil rubbed into hands to prevent them from sticking, until dough is soft and pliable. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 8 pieces; roll into balls. Dust balls with flour and cover with a damp cloth. Roll each ball out to a 3-inch round, keeping unrolled balls and finished rounds covered with a cloth.
Half-fill a deep pan or deep-fryer with oil and heat to 375°F or until a 1-inch bread cube browns in 50 seconds.
Fry poori one at a time, turning over once, for 30-60 seconds. Keep patting top of poories gently with a slotted spoon as they cook in order to make them puff up. Serve at once.

recipes.title: Blackbread
recipes.description: Dense, hearty dark rye bread with caraway seeds, perfect for slicing thin.

instructions.text: Mix the yeast, 1 tablespoon water and sugar in a large bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients in the order given. Beat well.
Put the dough on a floured board and knead well. Let rise on the board in a warm place until doubled in bulk.
Knead well again and shape into loaves. (5 small loaves are better than 3 standard-sized ones if you have pans smaller than 9 × 5 × 3.)
Put into greased pans and return to warm place to rise until again doubled in size.
Bake 10 minutes in a preheated 425° oven, then lower the heat to 325° and bake 1 hour more.
Slice very thin.

recipes.title: Jalapeño Cheese Bread
recipes.description: A savory yeast bread loaded with cheddar, Parmesan, and jalapeños with English mustard.

instructions.text: In a large bowl, mix the flour, cheeses, mustard powder, salt, jalapeños and yeast. Make a well in the middle and add the milk to make a soft, sticky dough.
Knead the dough on a light, floured surface until elastic and smooth.
Oil a large bowl and put the dough into the bowl, covering with oiled cling film, and leave in a warm(er the better) place for one and a half hours to rise.
Turn the dough onto the floured surface and knead again for another couple of minutes.
Oil a baking tray, and shape the dough into your chosen shape, and cover with well-oiled cling film and leave to rise for another half an hour.
Remove the cling film, glaze the loaf with beaten egg yolk, if you like at this point you can score the top with a criss-cross pattern or slashes, and then scatter the cheese over the top.

Bake in a preheated fan oven at 210°C (Gas mark 8) for ten minutes, then turn the temperature down to 180°C for a further 20 minutes. If the top starts to brown too much, you can cover it with tin foil loosely to prevent burning.
Remove from the oven and leave to cool on a wire rack.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
recipes.description: Traditional Irish soda bread with raisins, dates, orange zest, and honey - no yeast required.

instructions.text: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, raisins, and dates until combined and the raisins and dates are coated in the flour mixture. Grate the butter over the bowl on the largest hole setting, pausing and stirring the mixture every 10 seconds or so to coat the butter pieces in the flour mixture. Set aside.

In a small bowl, whisk together the egg, buttermilk, orange zest, and honey until the honey has dissolved into the liquid. Add the buttermilk mixture to the flour mixture and knead it together with your hands until a dough forms.

Take the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it for 3-4 turns, or until it comes together and has smoothed out a bit. Shape the dough into a ball, cover it, and place it in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 400°F. Remove the dough from the refrigerator, uncover it, and place it on a lightly greased 9-inch baking pan, patting it a couple times so it is slightly flattened on top.
Use a sharp knife to score a 1-inch deep cross in the top of the dough right before placing it in the oven.

Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until it's golden brown on top and a toothpick inserted into the dough comes out clean. Remove from the oven and allow to cool to room temperature before slicing and serving.

recipes.title: Olive French Bread
recipes.description: Crusty French-style bread studded with Nicoise olives, baked with steam for a crispy crust.

instructions.text: Insert the dough hook into an electric mixer and on 1 or low speed, combine 5 cups flour and the water for 4 minutes. Sprinkle the yeast over the dough, turn the speed to 2, and mix about 5 minutes longer. (Dough will pull cleanly away from the bowl.)
Toss the olives with the 2 teaspoons flour, add to the dough with the salt and mix 2 minutes longer.
Remove the bowl from the mixer, cover with a clean tea towel, and let rest for 15 minutes.
Turn the dough out on a heavily floured surface, lightly knead into a ball, and let rest, covered for 45 minutes.
Punch out the air, cut the dough in half, and shape into two baguettes. Place the loaves on one or two baking trays, sprinkle with flour, cover with the towel, and let rest for 45 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400°F.
With a single edge razor blade or a very sharp knife, make a slash down the center of each loaf.

Carefully slide the breads onto a baking stone and bake 10 minutes. Spray with water (a spray can or bottle used for misting plants works well) and continue baking until the bread is well-browned, about 1 hour and 10 minutes longer. (Baking at 400°F will give you a crustier bread, but you can bake the bread at 425°F for 1 hour, 10 minutes.)
Cool on a rack.

notes: Makes 2 loaves

recipes.title: Koulouri-Cypriot Village Bread
recipes.description: Traditional Cypriot bread coated with sesame and caraway seeds, flavored with fennel and cumin.

instructions.text: Grind the fennel seeds with a pestle and mortar or in a spice grinder.

Put the flour, salt, yeast, olive oil, and water in a large bowl and whisk together. Make sure not to pour the yeast directly on top of the salt, since salt is not good for active yeast. Add the fennel powder and knead for 5 minutes, or use the dough hook on your stand mixer for about 3 minutes.
Let dough stand in the bowl for at least 1 hour, until almost doubled in size.
Mix the seeds and cumin in a large bowl and dampen with warm water – this helps the seeds release their flavor.
Line a baking sheet with parchment or a silicone liner.

Take the dough out of the bowl and shape into a ball, dusting your surface with flour as necessary. Coat the ball of dough with the seeds in the bowl. Place on baking sheet and let rise for another hour.

Preheat oven to 425°F. Use a sharp knife or razor to make a cut around the edge of the dough and to make two parallel cuts on top (these cuts are optional, but definitely add some interesting shape and variety to the bread).
Bake the bread for 25-30 minutes, until golden brown and hollow-sounding when rapped on the bottom. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

recipes.title: Portuguese Sweet Bread
recipes.description: Traditional Portuguese sweet bread with a golden egg glaze, perfect for breakfast or holidays.

instructions.text: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl.
Stir in milk, 3/4 cup sugar, 3 eggs, salt, margarine or butter, and 3 cups of flour.
Beat until smooth. Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make the dough easy to handle.
Knead dough on a lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic - about 5 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl and let rise in a warm place until it is double in size - about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Punch down dough and divide in half. Shape each half into a round slightly flat loaf.
Place each loaf into a well greased round 9" x 1 1/2" pan. Cover and let rise until double (a/b an hour).
Heat oven to 350°F. Beat 1 egg and brush over tops of loaves.
Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of sugar. Bake until loaves are golden brown, about 35-45 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel Bacon Monkey Bread
recipes.description: A low-carb monkey bread made with Swerve sweetener, topped with bacon and homemade caramel sauce.

instructions.text: Bread: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a bundt pan well. In a small bowl, mix together cinnamon and sweetener.
Follow Maria's directions regarding the bread (I used only half the sweetener and half the salt), up to the point of mixing the dough together and giving it a few moments to thicken up.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place half of them in the prepared bundt pan (you may need to wet your hands a few times to keep the dough from sticking). Sprinkle with half of the cinnamon mixture.
Repeat with remaining dough and cinnamon mixture.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes, until puffed and browned and a tester inserted down into the center comes out clean. Let cool 15 minutes in pan.

Caramel Sauce: While the bread is baking, make the caramel sauce. Combine butter and sweeteners in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and cook about 3 minutes. If using all Swerve, you may find that your caramel remains lighter in colour (you can add a tsp of molasses for caramel colour and it will only add 6 g of carbs to the entire recipe).
Add heavy cream and vanilla extract. Mixture will bubble vigorously, this is normal. Sprinkle with xanthan gum and whisk vigorously to combine. Stir in salt.
Let cool to lukewarm and then whisk in water to combine.
To Assemble: Flip bread out onto a serving platter and drizzle with caramel sauce. Sprinkle with chopped bacon and serve warm.

recipes.title: Chili & Biscuits
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A hearty chili topped with homemade cornmeal biscuit dough, baked until golden.

instructions.text: In a large skillet, brown together beef, onion and celery. Drain; stir in seasoning mix and flour.
Add tomatoes with juice and remaining ingredients; simmer until thickened and bubbly.
Transfer to a lightly greased 13"x9" baking pan.
For Biscuit Dough: Combine dry ingredients and oil. Stir in enough milk to form a soft dough.
Drop Biscuit Dough by tablespoonfuls into hot chili.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes, until biscuits are golden.

recipes.title: Santa Fe Chicken Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A Southwestern-style chicken chili with corn, kidney beans, and salsa.

instructions.text: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, sauté chicken, garlic, onions and peppers in oil until chicken is no longer pink.
Add tomatoes with juice and remaining ingredients; simmer one hour.

recipes.title: Rio Grande Green Pork Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A slow-cooker pork chili with green chiles and jalapeños, featuring a rich tomato broth.

instructions.text: In a heavy skillet over medium heat, sauté pork and garlic in oil. Add flour, stirring until thoroughly mixed.
Drain; transfer browned pork to a slow cooker.
Add tomatoes with juice and remaining ingredients.
Cover and cook on low setting for 6 to 8 hours, until pork is tender.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Sweet Potato Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A vegetarian-friendly chili with sweet potatoes, black beans, and kidney beans, optionally with ground meat.

ingredients.item: canned diced jalapeños or hot pepper sauce

instructions.text: Combine tomatoes with juice and all ingredients except cheese in a slow cooker; stir to mix.
Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours, or on high setting for 4 to 5 hours.
Garnish servings with cheese.

recipes.title: Chicken & Barley Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A hearty chicken chili with pearled barley, corn, and kidney beans.

instructions.text: In a stockpot, combine tomatoes with juice, salsa, broth, barley, water and seasonings.
Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to low; simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add beans, corn and chicken. Increase heat to high; bring to a boil.
Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 5 minutes, or until barley is tender.
Ladle into bowls. Top with cheese and sour cream, if desired.

recipes.title: Black Bean Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A slow-cooker pork tenderloin chili with black beans and chunky salsa.

instructions.text: Place pork in a lightly greased slow cooker; add remaining ingredients except garnish.
Cover and cook on low setting for 8 hours, or on high setting for 4 hours.
Shred pork; return to slow cooker.
Garnish servings with dollops of sour cream and diced tomatoes.

recipes.title: Fireside Chili Pot
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A quick and easy chili using canned chili, rice, and topped with olives and cheese.

instructions.text: Mix together chili, rice, onion and green pepper in a large saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes, or until bubbly.
Sprinkle with olives and cheese; continue to cook until cheese melts, about 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Steak Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A hearty slow-cooker chili with beef round steak, kidney beans, and a thickened sauce.

instructions.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat; add beef, onion and garlic. Cook until beef is browned and onion and garlic are translucent.
Drain; transfer beef mixture to a large slow cooker.
Add one cup water, celery, beans, tomatoes with juice, salsa, sauce and seasonings; stir.
Cover and cook on low setting for 8 hours.
Shortly before serving time, place flour, cornmeal and remaining water in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
Add mixture to simmering chili; stir for 2 minutes, until thickened.
Garnish as desired.

recipes.title: The Great Pumpkin Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A unique fall-inspired chili featuring canned pumpkin with honey and a touch of sweetness.

instructions.text: Brown beef in a large stockpot over medium heat, stirring to crumble; drain.
Stir in tomatoes with juice and remaining ingredients; reduce heat to low.
Simmer, covered, for one to 2 hours, adding water as necessary.

recipes.title: Cincinnati-Style Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: Classic Cincinnati chili with warm spices like cinnamon, allspice, and nutmeg, served over spaghetti.

instructions.text: Combine uncooked beef and water in a large stockpot.
Add remaining ingredients except spaghetti and cheese.
Simmer over medium heat for 3 hours, stirring often.
Discard bay leaves.
Serve chili ladled over spaghetti and topped with cheese.

recipes.title: Garlicky Green Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A flavorful green chili with pork, green chiles, and fresh cilantro.

instructions.text: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, brown pork in oil.
Mix in flour; cook and stir for one minute.
Add garlic, salt and pepper; cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in remaining ingredients; simmer for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Ivan's Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A traditional from-scratch chili using dried kidney beans, slow-simmered for hours.

instructions.text: In a stockpot, cover beans with water and soak overnight; drain and rinse.
